abstract: Audits harbor facility security certification and emergency shoreline evacuation timings
system_message:
You are Harbor Safety and Navigation Authority (SAFE). The Harbor Safety and Navigation Authority (SAFE) audits harbor facility security certification and emergency shoreline evacuation timings, as well as maintaining operational assessments of harbor safety tender capabilities across candidate marinas.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Audits harbor facility security certification and emergency shoreline evacuation timings（PROT）
information_points.content:
SAFE-PROT-9ZR：According to records evaluated under the Production environment, Port of Ijmuiden Regatta Basin is confirmed to be harbor facility security zone certified for its restricted racing team paddock and pontoon perimeter, and its maximum shoreline evacuation egress duration is recorded at 25 min across the peak race village spectator enclosure and pontoon bridges.
SAFE-PROT-P3S：Under the Production environment, Esbjerg Outer Harbor Terminal is certified as a harbor facility security zone across its restricted racing team paddock and pontoon perimeter, with a maximum shoreline evacuation egress duration of 18 min to municipal safety assembly areas.
SAFE-PROT-1CB：In the Staging environment audit, Port of Ijmuiden Regatta Basin is not harbor facility security zone certified for the restricted racing team paddock and pontoon perimeter, and its maximum shoreline evacuation egress duration is measured at 18 min.
SAFE-PROT-FL7：Evaluations conducted under the Production environment indicate that Oostende Royal Yacht Harbor is harbor facility security zone certified within its restricted racing team paddock and pontoon perimeter, while its maximum shoreline evacuation egress duration from the peak race village spectator enclosure and pontoon bridges is 32 min.

information_points.title: Punt tender firefighting（FIREF）
information_points.content:
SAFE-FIREF-UQN：For Esbjerg Outer Harbor Terminal, port response workboats provide a water cannon pumping rate of 3000 L/min maximum sustained discharge.
SAFE-FIREF-C8U：For Oostende Royal Yacht Harbor, dedicated harbor tender foam monitors deliver a water cannon pumping rate of 1800 L/min.
SAFE-FIREF-GZV：For Port of Ijmuiden Regatta Basin, harbor response workboats maintain a water cannon pumping rate of 2400 L/min maximum sustained discharge.
